service.ur: سیاحوں کے لیے ویلیو ایڈڈ ٹیکس کی واپسی

about: Claim back the VAT paid on eligible goods bought from registered shops before leaving the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. VAT refund for tourists. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Must have entered the UAE as a tourist, be 18 or older and not be a UAE resident
Purchases must be from retailers registered in the tourist refund scheme and be eligible goods
Minimum spend is AED 250 before VAT per refund transaction
Only the person whose passport or GCC ID was used can start or complete validation
documents: Original valid passport or GCC national ID card (copies are not accepted)
The purchased goods, which may be inspected
A valid ticket or confirmed booking showing departure from the UAE
An online boarding pass when using a kiosk in a mall or hotel (departure within 24 hours)
fees: 13% of the VAT amount requested plus AED 3.60 per tax-free transaction
timing: Validate within 90 days of the tax invoice date
Leave within 6 hours of validation or the approval is cancelled
About 5 minutes at a staffed desk, about 3 at a kiosk
Bank card refund within 9 calendar days, cash in about 3 minutes
channels: Planet validation desks and self-service kiosks at exit points
Kiosks at selected malls and hotels
Planet Shopper Portal or Planet Tax Free ME app to track a claim
